scope: Two actual US commercial products and retained US manufacturer soybean-aphid directions. Reference simulation only; not a Chinese registration or complete regulatory label model.

products.name: Transform WG
products.source_rates: 0.75–1.0 oz product/acre; minimum interval14d; PHI7d; max4 applications; max8.5oz/acre/year. Manufacturer soybean fact sheet dated08/2019. No more than two consecutive applications per crop.

products.name: Sefina Inscalis
products.source_rates: 3fl oz product/acre; minimum interval7d; PHI7d; seasonal6fl oz/acre implies at most2 applications at listed rate. Manufacturer soybean bulletin2019.

observation_reference.rule: 250aphids/plant,80% infested and increasing through R5; simulator returns aphid-equivalent diagnostics, not real field counts.

simulation_assumptions.price_source: Unverified product-specific China price estimates. US brands/labels retained for continuity; do not claim these are registered Chinese soybean SKUs or observed 2025 Northeast quotes. A source-verified Chinese product catalogue is a separate agronomic change.
simulation_assumptions.effect_source: Both products use the same existing FAIRY reduced insecticide effect at an allowed dose:65% initial pressure reduction,10d residual,55% growth suppression,weather dependent. No product-specific field efficacy or resistance claim.
simulation_assumptions.service_scope: Contracted ground application, one product per ridge per seven days; no tank mixtures. This service rule is a declared operating condition, separate from manufacturer directions.
